title: K-injective preservation for finite-free strict scalar extension
statement: For a finite free integral coefficient extension E → F and scheme W, tensor extension on strict coefficient towers preserves K-injective complexes.

proof.text: The dual basis identifies scalar extension with a finite coinduction functor. The coinduction functor is right adjoint to an exact finite-coordinate functor; apply Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes.

source.place: Finite-free dual-basis exactness and K-injective adjunction criterion
